E-Commerce ERD

erDiagram
    User {
        int id PK
        str name
        str email
        UserRole role "default USER"
        bool is_active "default True"
        str bio "nullable, default None"
    }
    Product {
        int id PK
        str name
        float price
        str description "nullable, default None"
        bool in_stock "default True"
    }
    Order {
        int id PK
        int user_id FK
        OrderStatus status "default PENDING"
        float total
        str notes "nullable, default None"
    }
    OrderItem {
        int id PK
        int order_id FK
        int product_id FK
        int quantity
        float unit_price
    }
    UserProductLink {
        int user_id PK,FK
        int product_id PK,FK
    }
    OrderStatus {
        enum PENDING
        enum PROCESSING
        enum COMPLETED
        enum CANCELLED
    }
    UserRole {
        enum ADMIN
        enum USER
        enum GUEST
    }
    Order }o--|| User : "user_id"
    OrderItem }o--|| Order : "order_id"
    OrderItem }o--|| Product : "product_id"
    User ||--o{ UserProductLink : "user_id"
    UserProductLink }o--|| Product : "product_id"
